title: Chicken thighs with shallots and cherry tomatoes

ingredients.name: whole medium shallots, peeled and halved

steps.text: Rinse thighs and pat very dry with paper towels. Sprinkle over them with flour, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in large, heavy-bottomed pot or skillet and set over medium-high heat. When butter foams, cook chicken, in batches if necessary, until well browned and crisp on all sides. Set aside.

Add shallots to pot and saute them in butter and chicken fat until they begin to soften and caramelize (about 10-12 minutes). Add wine to deglaze the pan, add mustard and taragon, then chicken thighs. Cover, turn heat to low, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove lid, allow sauce to reduce and thicken, 15-20 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes, stir to combine, and serve immediately.

notes: Goes well just with crusty bread and a simple salad. Can replace some/all shallots with onions Instead of 2 cups wine, can use some combination of wine and stock, plus a bit of brandy, sherry, or cognac if you have it.
